findings.remedy: Run this yourself on the server:

list.title: Migrations
list.subtitle: Move whole databases from one server to another, with verification before cutover.
list.emptyHint: Pick a source and a target server, run the read-only pre-flight, and review the plan before anything is changed.

new.title: Plan a migration
new.subtitle: Four steps. Nothing on either server changes until you approve the plan.

choose.heading: Which servers?
choose.rolesNote: A server has no fixed role. Source and target are chosen for each migration, so the same server can be a source in one migration and a target in another.
choose.sourceHint: The server the data is moved from. It is only read, except for the changes shown in the plan.
choose.targetHint: The server the data is moved to.
choose.sameServer: Source and target must be different servers.
choose.mysqlTitle: MySQL migration is not built yet
choose.mysqlBody: Only PostgreSQL to PostgreSQL migration exists. MySQL migration is planned for a later phase (Phase 5). You can still monitor MySQL servers.

preflight.heading: Pre-flight check
preflight.readOnlyBody: The pre-flight only reads settings, roles, sizes and counts from {{source}} and {{target}}. It never reads your data and never changes either server.
preflight.failed: The pre-flight could not be completed.
preflight.blockedBody: Apply the remedies yourself on the servers, then run the pre-flight again. Lockkeeper never fixes blockers silently.
preflight.warningsBody: Warnings do not block the migration, but read them before you continue.

plan.heading: Review the plan
plan.failed: The plan could not be built.
plan.hashHint: The server computes this over the exact plan below. Approval is only accepted for this hash.
plan.sourceHint: These statements change the source. Read each one: they are exactly what will be run.
plan.targetHint: These steps run against the target, or read the source without changing it.

approve.heading: Approve the plan
approve.warnTitle: You are approving changes to the source server
approve.warnBody: Approving the plan for {{source}} to {{target}} allows the changes in the source section of the plan. Nothing is deleted on the source.
approve.typeThis: To approve, type this phrase exactly:
approve.label: Confirmation phrase
approve.hint: Pasting is allowed. The server checks the phrase and the plan hash again; this page cannot skip either check.
approve.auditBody: Approval is recorded in the audit log with the approving user and requires the admin role. This prototype has no sign-in yet, so no user is recorded here.
approve.failed: The plan could not be approved.

plan_hash_mismatch.title: The plan changed
plan_hash_mismatch.body: The plan changed since it was shown, so your approval was not accepted. Review the new plan before approving it.

confirmation_mismatch.body: The confirmation text does not match the phrase. Type it exactly as shown.

run.title: Migration
run.subtitle: Migration {{id}}
run.notFoundBody: There is no migration with the id {{id}}.
run.notFoundHint: It may have been removed, or the address may be wrong.
run.endedBody: This migration is no longer running. Check the source: its replication slots may still retain WAL until they are cleaned up.
run.phase4Note: Verification, cutover and cleanup are not built yet. Until they are, this screen cannot finish a migration safely.
run.rollbackTitle: After cutover, writes on the target do not flow back to the source
run.rollbackBody: Once applications write to the target, the source no longer receives those changes. Going back means losing them or copying them back by hand. The rollback window is recorded and blocks cleanup.
run.actionsUnavailable: Abort and cleanup arrive with the real backend (stage U3). In this prototype they do nothing, so they are disabled.
